content: The Founder looks at the grid, a little wary. 'Numbering is the whole point. If collectors don't care about the number, what do they care about?'
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

content: Head of Product hands the marker to Community. 'Your item. The report's hypothesis is that collectors wanted legitimacy before scarcity. What would make a number mean something?'
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

content: Research answers the Founder directly. 'They might care about the number a lot. The report doesn't say scarcity is worthless. It says scarcity wasn't enough on its own for simulated people. Real collectors could be different. That's why it's a hypothesis.'
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

content: Brand stands up beside the grid. 'A number means something when it's verifiable and final. Proposal: we state publicly that Archive 001 will never be remade or restocked, and that 100 means 100. Scarcity you can check is legitimacy.'
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

proposals.text: Public 'never remade, 100 means 100' statement for each Archive
proposals.test: collector sentiment and reseller-rumour frequency in comments

content: The Designer adds a physical idea. 'And make the number checkable on the object itself: painted number plus a matching number on the lid card. Two places that agree make it harder to fake and easier to prove.'
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

proposals.text: Matching number on the tin and on the lid card

content: The Plant Specialist watches the grid fill in. They notice, without saying it, that some of the report's collectors said the bloom mattered as much as the number.
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

content: Growth jumps on the grid. 'Make that grid real. A highlight on the profile: every number that's been claimed, with the buyer's unboxing if they agree. As boxes fill up, the drop sells itself.'
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

content: Community fills in box 001 with a small tick. 'Proposal, three pieces. One: an opt-in public registry, number, first name or handle, a photo if they want. Two: a pinned post that answers rumours in the open. The reseller rumour got answered in a comment thread in the report. It should be a post anyone can find. Three: blooms. When a buyer's marigold flowers, with permission, it goes in the registry next to their number. Legitimacy that grows.'
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

proposals.text: Opt-in public number registry (number, handle, optional unboxing/bloom photo) as an Instagram highlight
proposals.test: share of buyers opting in; waitlist conversion from profile visits

proposals.text: Pinned 'rumours, answered' post in the founder's own words, updated openly

content: CX adds one condition. 'Dead seeds go in the registry too, if the buyer is fine with it, alongside what we did about it. A registry with only blooms in it is the selective proof Research warned us about.'
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

content: Ops raises one practical point. 'If 100 means 100, then damage replacements can't come from a 101st painted tin. I'll keep the replacements unnumbered, or repaint the same number. We need to decide which before we promise.'
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

proposals.text: Damage replacement rule under '100 means 100': repaint the same number rather than create a 101st

content: Finance notices that repainting the same number for a damaged tin means paying painting time twice for one sale. Probably rare, but they add a line to the damage exposure they still haven't been able to sign off.
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors

content: Legal: 'Never remade has to stay true for as long as the brand exists, so only say it if the Founder is sure. Registry entries follow the consent rule from item 4. Verify the scarcity wording with a professional.'
round_time: Late afternoon, Day 2 - Pain point 6: scarcity alone does not win collectors
